description: A comprehensive shell script for setting up, configuring, and managing Docker-based deployment for the OpenClaw project. It handles environment setup, validates prerequisites, builds or pulls Docker images, configures Docker Compose overlays, manages sandbox environment setup, and starts the OpenClaw gateway service with additional optional configurations, including volume mounting, token management, and sandbox isolation.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs error message to stderr and exits the script with a non-zero status.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system's PATH; exits if not found.

methods.name: run_docker_build
methods.description: Builds a Docker image with BuildKit enabled, passing all arguments to 'docker build'.

methods.name: is_truthy_value
methods.description: Determines if a given string value represents a boolean true (1, true, yes, on).

methods.name: read_config_gateway_token
methods.description: Attempts to read the gateway token from a JSON config file using Python or Node, returns token if found.

methods.name: read_env_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from an environment variables file.

methods.name: ensure_control_ui_allowed_origins
methods.description: Configures the control UI allowed origins if not already set, based on gateway port.

methods.name: sync_gateway_mode_and_bind
methods.description: Sets gateway mode and bind configuration for Docker.

methods.name: run_prestart_gateway
methods.description: Runs a docker compose command for the gateway service with specified parameters.

methods.name: run_prestart_cli
methods.description: Runs a CLI command within the openclaw-gateway container via Docker Compose.

methods.name: contains_disallowed_chars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains newline, tab, or carriage return characters.

methods.name: is_valid_timezone
methods.description: Verifies if a timezone string corresponds to a valid timezone in /usr/share/zoneinfo.

methods.name: validate_mount_path_value
methods.description: Ensures a mount path value is non-empty, contains no disallowed characters or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_named_volume
methods.description: Checks that a volume name matches allowed naming conventions.

methods.name: validate_mount_spec
methods.description: Validates the format of a mount specification string.

methods.name: upsert_env
methods.description: Updates or inserts environment variable key-value pairs into a file.

methods.name: write_extra_compose
methods.description: Generates an overlay Docker Compose YAML file with additional volume mounts based on inputs.
